title: yituorou/meatshell
claim: yituorou/meatshell — 一个轻量级、低内存占用的 SSH / 终端客户端（A lightweight, low-memory SSH / terminal client）
why_good: A lightweight, low-memory SSH/terminal client with early pull (1,180 stars, actively maintained) — a real niche for people on constrained machines.
value: Charge a pro/team tier (sync, vaulted credentials, team access) like Termius does on top of a free core.
risk: Termius/iTerm/Windows Terminal are entrenched; a lean client needs a sharp speed/UX wedge to convert payers.

zh.claim: yituorou/meatshell —— 一个轻量、低内存占用的 SSH / 终端客户端。
zh.why_good: 一个轻量、低内存的 SSH/终端客户端,早期有牵引(1180★、活跃维护)——对受限机器的人是真实细分。
zh.value: 像 Termius 那样在免费核心上卖专业/团队版(同步、凭证保险箱、团队访问)。
zh.risk: Termius/iTerm/Windows Terminal 根基深;精简客户端要靠锋利的速度/体验切口才能转化付费。

pick_reason: The project addresses a specific need for a lightweight SSH client, showing potential for a niche market.
